CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Stewardship over Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Stewardship over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stewardship over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship over Creation.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.
   B. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Leadership in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Leadership in Israel has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Use of Natural Resources? (1 mark)
   A. Use Use of Natural Resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Use of Natural Resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Use of Natural Resources has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Use of Natural Resources.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say Divisions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Bible.
   C. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Divisions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Translation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Translation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Translation.
   C. Use Bible Translation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Bible Translation has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Responsibility over Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Responsibility over Plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Responsibility over Plants has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Responsibility over Plants.
   D. Use Responsibility over Plants to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

11. Which response best shows understanding of Prophecies about the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Prophecies about the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophecies about the Messiah.
   C. Say Prophecies about the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Prophecies about the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Accounts of Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Accounts of Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Accounts of Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Accounts of Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Accounts of Creation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Human Sexuality 7 6.2 Christian Marriage and Family 7 6.3 Alcohol, drugs and sub and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Human Sexuality and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Christian Marriage and Family and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Alcohol, drugs and substance use 7 6.4 Gambling 6 6.5 Social Media 7 Total Numbe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
